text: Oh, fuck. You have fucking head lice!
So you scratch. And scratch. And scratch, god damn it!
But these little shits? They think it's a fucking theme park!
Shampoo? Ha ha! That's their god damn pool party!
The comb? Those motherfuckers built a town. With a flag!
We live here now, bitch! Fuck you!
Luxury real estate, baby! Free wig. Zero fucking scratching.
And the little bastards just... moved the fuck out.
Lice free. Rent free. Fuck yes!
